Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state.

InternalError.description: An internal error occurred; sensitive details are not returned.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

TooManyRequests.description: The legacy or target rate limit was exceeded.

ApiEnvelope.description: Canonical /api/v1 success envelope. Downloads and event streams are not wrapped. Legacy compatibility operations keep observed shapes until migration is approved.

ApiStatus.description: Common legacy status values; target /api/v1 envelopes use the boolean success discriminator.
ApiStatus.x-ti-enum-policy: closed-wire-values; additions require a reviewed contract change

DecimalString.description: Canonical base-10 decimal string; binary floating point and exponent notation are forbidden.
DecimalString.x-ti-scale-policy: each concrete property must declare scale and rounding in its reviewed contract

ErrorCode.description: Stable target error code; values are reviewed as part of each operation contract.
ErrorCode.x-ti-enum-policy: closed per operation; additions require a reviewed contract change

ErrorDetail.description: Sanitized validation detail; never contains stack traces, SQL, credentials, or upstream raw bodies.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical /api/v1 error envelope; details is optional and must not expose secrets or stacks.

Instant.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit offset; target serialization uses UTC Z.
Instant.x-ti-time-policy: UTC at API boundaries; preserve source timezone before conversion

LegacyErrorCode.description: Compatibility-only code shape. Exact values remain operation-specific evidence.

LegacyErrorEnvelope.description: Compatibility-only error shape; each operation still needs observed status/payload evidence.

LegacyOpaquePayload.description: Compatibility placeholder for a legacy payload whose schema has not been proven. It intentionally places no JSON type constraints and cannot prove migration completeness.

LocalDateTime.description: Local wall-clock time without offset; only for domains whose timezone is separately fixed.

username.description: Legacy identifier: any trimmed value containing @, or a mainland China mobile number.

LoginRequest.x-ti-legacy-extra-fields: Pydantic default behavior ignores unknown input fields

MoneyDecimal.description: Currency amount with exactly two fractional digits.

NullableId.description: Nullable positive database identifier; null is not equivalent to zero or omission.
NullableId.x-ti-null-policy: null and omitted are distinct wire states

NullableString.description: Explicit null means no value; omission means the producer did not include the field.
NullableString.x-ti-null-policy: null and omitted are distinct wire states

PageEnvelope.description: Canonical /api/v1 list envelope; pagination is always meta.pagination.

data.description: Concrete list operations must replace UnknownPayload with their item schema.

PaginationMeta.x-ti-pagination-policy: one-based page; page_size defaults to 20 and is at most 100 unless an operation proves another bound; total_items counts the full filtered result

clear_mistake_on_correct.x-ti-legacy-coercion: false/0/no/off strings map to false; other values use boolean coercion

is_correct.x-ti-legacy-coercion: handler applies Python truthiness to non-boolean input; clients must send boolean

request_id.description: Must equal the authoritative X-Request-ID response header.

ScoreDecimal.description: Exact assessment score. The operation or field contract must declare its scale and rounding rule.

UnknownPayload.description: Generic JSON value used only as a type parameter placeholder in target shared components. Concrete /api/v1 operations must replace it with an explicit schema.

accessToken.description: Target short-lived mini-program access token. No current compatibility operation references it.

csrfHeader.description: Target SPA CSRF token. It is combined with the target secure Session cookie, not used by legacy operations.
csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN

legacyBearerJwt.description: Legacy mini-program JWT compatibility, including session_version semantics.

legacySessionCookie.description: Legacy Flask signed session compatibility. Target Web sessions use hardened cookies.
legacySessionCookie.name: session

legacyXRequestedWith.description: Legacy write gate expects XMLHttpRequest for session-authenticated writes; this is not authentication by itself.
legacyXRequestedWith.name: X-Requested-With

recordToken.description: Scoped legacy admin automation token; never include its value in this contract.
recordToken.name: X-AI-Record-Token

servers.description: Relative compatibility base; deployment host and port are environment-specific.

x-ti-contract-policy.manual_contracts: Each override names immutable route IDs and source evidence; unmatched or unused overrides fail validation.
x-ti-contract-policy.path_method_collisions: Exactly one effective Flask rule can become an OpenAPI Operation. Every shadowed rule remains in x-ti-shadowed-operations.
x-ti-contract-policy.path_template_conflicts: Templated paths with the same hierarchy require an explicit resolution before generation.
x-ti-contract-policy.unknown_schema: Unknown request, parameter, and response shapes remain explicit in x-ti-contract and UnknownPayload; an inventory-only route must never receive a fabricated DTO.

categories.reason: These static/dynamic Flask path hierarchies are frozen legacy facts. Flask converter precedence remains authoritative; changing paths would break compatibility.
Trailing slash is part of each frozen compatibility path and cannot be normalized before its clients and status/redirect behavior are migrated.
Shared target and error components are declared before /api/v1 operations consume them; target-only security schemes must remain unused by legacy operations.

x-ti-shadowed-operations.reason: The runtime URL map registers main.main_pages.profile_page first; Werkzeug therefore matches it and leaves user.user_pages.profile unreachable for GET /profile.
